infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Warrilo needs camera access to take photos of your devices and receipts.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Warrilo needs photo library access to select images of your devices and receipts.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Warrilo needs microphone access for video recording features.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Warrilo to access your photo library to select device images and receipts.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Warrilo to access your camera to take device photos.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Warrilo to access your microphone for video recording.
